blurb: The oldest university in the English-speaking world.

facts.t: There was teaching in Oxford by 1096, and it grew quickly after 1167, when Henry II banned English students from Paris.

src.n: Wikipedia: History of the University of Oxford

facts.t: Robert Hooke worked in Oxford as Robert Boyle's assistant in the late 1650s, building the air pump that showed how gas pressure works.
